skill.name: gemini-image
skill.description: Generate images from text or image URLs through a third-party Gemini image API.
skill.summary: Turn natural-language requests and image references into generated image links.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, placeholder URLs, standard installation paths, and plain README content. Confirmed behavior includes shell execution, external API requests, and transmission of an API credential to api.apicore.ai. The differing registration and API domains create an unclear credential trust boundary, and the registration link contains an undisclosed affiliate parameter.

remediation.issue: The skill reads an API key from a Markdown secrets file and sends it in an authorization header.
remediation.suggestion: Use an environment variable or secret manager, restrict file permissions, avoid logging, and require confirmation before sending the credential.

remediation.issue: The API key registration domain differs from the API endpoint domain.
remediation.suggestion: Document the relationship between ismaque.org and apicore.ai, identify the service operator, and obtain consent before transmitting prompts, image URLs, or credentials.

remediation.issue: The registration URL contains an affiliate parameter without disclosure.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the commercial relationship and provide a clean, non-referral registration URL.

content.value_statement: Creating image requests manually requires prompt formatting and API setup. This skill converts text or image references into requests for a third-party image generation API.
actual_capabilities: Formats natural-language descriptions as text-to-image prompts.
Accepts one image URL for image-to-image generation.
Accepts multiple image URLs as visual references.
Posts generation requests to the api.apicore.ai endpoint with curl.
Extracts the first generated image URL from the API response.
Documents three Gemini preview model variants and ten aspect ratios.
limitations: Requires a third-party API key and outbound network access.
Referenced configuration, secret, and upload guidance files are absent from the reviewed package.
Image-based requests require accessible image URLs before generation.
The instructions do not define error handling, retries, content moderation, or response validation.

use_cases.title: Create Concept Illustrations
use_cases.description: Generate visual concepts from concise descriptions for early design exploration.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Variations
use_cases.description: Create image variations in specified aspect ratios for social and promotional assets.

use_cases.title: Prototype Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Test text-to-image and reference-image requests through a conversational agent.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a direct text-to-image request.

prompt_templates.title: Set Composition and Ratio
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [aspect ratio] image of [subject], with [lighting], [composition], and [color direction].
prompt_templates.scenario: Control the basic visual layout and mood.

prompt_templates.title: Transform a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [image URL] as a reference. Recreate it with [requested changes] while preserving [important elements].

prompt_templates.title: Combine Multiple References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [first image URL] and [second image URL] as references. Combine [element one] with [element two] using [model and aspect ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: Build an advanced multi-reference generation request.

output_examples.input: Generate a 16:9 watercolor landscape with mountains at sunrise.
output_examples.output: A link to the first generated watercolor landscape returned by the image API.

output_examples.input: Use the supplied image URL and create a similar composition in a paper-cut style.
output_examples.output: A link to the first generated variation based on the supplied reference image.

best_practices: Describe the subject, style, lighting, composition, and aspect ratio explicitly.
Use accessible image URLs and confirm that sharing them with the API is permitted.
Review generated images for accuracy, rights, privacy, and policy compliance before use.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys directly in prompts, chat messages, or version-controlled files.
Do not send private, licensed, or sensitive images without authorization.
Do not assume placeholder models, files, or endpoints are available without verification.

faq.question: Does this skill support text-to-image generation?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends a natural-language prompt to the configured third-party image API.

faq.question: Can it modify an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an accessible image URL and describe the requested changes.

faq.question: Can it use multiple reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions accept multiple image URLs followed by a description.

faq.question: Which image sizes are documented?
faq.answer: The README lists ten aspect ratios, including square, landscape, portrait, and ultrawide formats.

faq.question: Is an API key required?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires a bearer credential for the external API.

faq.question: Does the package include every referenced setup file?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only README.md and SKILL.md, so several referenced files are unavailable.
